evidence.title: Social Media Skills for AI Agents README

name: Social Media Skills for AI Agents
summary: Claude skills for social media: voice building, LinkedIn and newsletter writing, Reels, thumbnails, hooks, scoring and analytics.
description: The skill set behind Charlie Hills' content system (415k+ followers, 100m+ views per year): building a voice foundation, then writing and optimising content for LinkedIn, Instagram Reels, YouTube and a newsletter. Skills cover post writing, hook generation, carousels and infographics, thumbnail concepts, content matrices, niche research, post scoring, pinned comments and an analytics dashboard. Installs via a Claude Code plugin marketplace, cloning, individual upload, git submodule or fork.
